comment: Flange per the CAT40 (V-flange) standard (ASME B5.50, flange 2.50 in = 63.5 mm); the body and nose are a conservative generic envelope for collision checks; nose: ER32 collet nut about 50 mm across (ISO 15488 ER32 collets). Measure your own holders and correct the segments.
name: CAT40 ER32 collet chuck, 70 mm gauge
